description:
About Chalk:

Chalk https://chalk.ai is the platform for production AI. Trusted by enterprises including Whatnot, Grindr, Mission Lane, Turo, and Apartment List, Chalk brings together context, runtime, and learning for agents and models. Chalk’s Context Engine delivers live context by querying data across warehouses, databases, streams, and APIs, straight from the source. Chalk’s runtime powers agents and models with infrastructure and governed access to LLMs and tools. Together, these capabilities help teams build AI that understands their business, continuously improves, and runs reliably in production. We've raised a $50 million Series A, led by Felicis. Learn more at chalk.ai https://chalk.ai.

 

About the role:

We're hiring an experienced software engineer to oversee security at Chalk. This is an opportunity to join us in-person as our first security engineer and make a large impact at a high growth start-up.

Large companies in regulated industries run production models on Chalk for decisions like fraud, credit and risk, and their security teams look closely at what we ship. We run Chalk for them as a hosted service, inside their own AWS and GCP accounts, and in airgapped environments, and each deployment has its own threat model.

Customers also run their own code on Chalk, and functions, sandboxes and AI agents from different customers share infrastructure, so isolation has to hold even when that code is hostile. AI makes this harder, since agents call tools with real credentials and prompt injection turns untrusted data into instructions.

Most days you'll be in the code yourself, across a Go control plane that manages deployments on Kubernetes, a query engine written in C++ and Rust that serves 100k QPS at 5ms latency, and a Python SDK and TypeScript frontend on top. You'll work hand in hand with the engineers who own each layer, from the first design review through to production.

 

We're in the SF or NY office 5 days a week. When unavoidable conflicts come up, we’re flexible. This is not a hybrid role.

 

What you will do:

 - Help set Chalk's security priorities and decide what gets fixed first

 - Build detection and incident response for the platform, and lead the response when something goes wrong

 - Harden our infrastructure across AWS, GCP, Kubernetes and Terraform, including deployments into customer clouds

 - Build the security tooling we can't buy, such as abuse and fraud detection for self-sign-up

 - Build security checks into CI: SAST, DAST, dependency and secrets scanning. Tune them until engineers trust the results

 - Work with customers' security teams on reviews and questionnaires, and explain how Chalk protects their data

 - Help interview and grow Engineering

 

What we're looking for:

 - 7+ years as a software engineer, with several of those years focused on application, cloud or infrastructure security

 - You ship production code in Go, Python or TypeScript, and can read C++ or Rust

 - Experience securing AWS or GCP and Kubernetes in production

 - Hands-on red-team experience: you've found and exploited vulnerabilities in production systems

 - You work independently: you find the gaps, decide what to fix first, and ship the fixes yourself

 - Strong written and verbal communication with engineers and with customers

 - BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience

 

Bonus points:

 - You've secured a platform that runs untrusted customer code: sandboxes, serverless functions or notebooks

 - You've attacked or defended LLM applications and AI agents in production

 - You've secured software that ships both as multi-tenant SaaS and inside customers' own clouds
   

 

Benefits:

⚕️Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance

🏦 Flexible Spending Account (FSA), Health Savings Account (HSA)

🦮 Expert Healthcare Guidance

💵 Retirement savings

🎄15 company holidays each year

🏖️15 days of personal time off each year

🚌 Flex Commuter Benefits

🌮 Daily lunch and dinner on Chalk

🥤Office is fully-stocked with drinks and snacks to fuel your work day.

🍽️ Staying late? Dinner is on us

🚖 Staying even later? Grab an Uber / Lyft home on Chalk

 

Compensation:

Salary: $170,000 – $280,000 - Offers equity + benefits

Chalk offers early team members a generous salary + equity package based on experience and competitive benefits.

Actual compensation awarded to successful candidates will be based on several factors, including but not limited to: market, location, scope of the position and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process.

Our comprehensive total package plays a major role in how we recognize individuals for the impact they will have on Chalk’s growth and us achieving our goals.

 

Inclusivity:

Chalk is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and inclusion and provide reasonable accommodations to anyone in need of individualized support.
